strings.long_src: Oh! There's a taxi parked just where￥we need one.

strings.en: Такси с живым водителем. Он внутри.
strings.en_src: It's a taxi with a human driver.￥He's inside.
Illegally parked out front.￥Awaiting a fare.
strings.long_src: It's parked illegally in front of￥the building. He's probably waiting￥for a fare.
strings.long: Стоит у дома в неположенном месте.￥Наверное, ждёт клиента.

strings.en_src: Sealed off against Snatcher￥infection. Nobody lives here now.
strings.long_src: The building is quarantined to￥prevent Snatcher infiltration. No￥one lives here now.
strings.long: Здание на карантине, чтобы сюда не￥проникли снатчеры. Сейчас тут никто￥не живёт.

strings.en: Опечатано лентой оцепления. Следов,￥что сюда кто-то заходил, нет.
strings.en_src: Sealed with scene tape. No sign of￥anyone but us calling here.
strings.long_src: It's sealed with crime scene tape.￥There's no sign of anyone else￥coming here.

strings.en: До больницы "Куин" отсюда далеко.￥Здесь очень тихо.
strings.en_src: We're a long way from Queen￥Hospital. It's very quiet.
Fewer people about than usual today.
strings.long_src: There seem to be fewer people around￥than usual today.
strings.long: Сегодня, похоже, людей на улице￥меньше обычного.

strings.long_src: It looks available. Shall we get in?

strings.en_src: A black taxi, but never mind.￥Let's get in.
strings.long_src: It's an unlicensed taxi, but we have￥no choice. Let's get in.

strings.en: Куда едем? С живым водителем можно￥куда угодно.
strings.en_src: Where to? With a human driver, you￥can go anywhere.

strings.long_src: Give destination

strings.en: Срочное дело. Вези нас в штаб￥ДЖАНКЕРа, быстро.
strings.en_src: It's urgent. Get me to JUNKER HQ,￥and hurry.
strings.long_src: It's an emergency. Get us to JUNKER￥headquarters, fast.

strings.en: Что? В штаб ДЖАНКЕРа? Вам туда?￥Что-то случилось?
strings.en_src: What? JUNKER headquarters? You're￥going there? Did something happen?

strings.long_src: We're in a hurry!

strings.en: Не шутите так. У меня такси с живым￥водителем. Не можете вы туда ехать.
strings.en_src: Don't joke around. This is a taxi￥with a human driver. You can't￥really be going there.
Metal, we picked a strange taxi.

strings.en: Я ДЖАНКЕР. Вези нас в штаб ДЖАНКЕРа,￥живо!
strings.en_src: I'm a JUNKER. Get us to JUNKER￥headquarters, now!

strings.en: Ваш маршрут уже решён. Вы едете...
strings.en_src: Where you're going is fixed. It￥is...
strings.long_src: Your destination's already decided.￥You're going to...
To where?
Chin Shu Ho!＠Ｃ
Interior

strings.en_src: The car is altered to manual only.
strings.long_src: The car has been modified for manual￥operation only.
It appears to have been modified for￥use as an unlicensed taxi.

strings.en_src: He won't turn this way.￥A black taxi; bad if his face￥is seen.
strings.long_src: He doesn't want to turn around. As￥an unlicensed driver, he probably￥doesn't want us to see his face.
strings.long: Он не хочет оборачиваться. Нелегал,￥наверное, не хочет, чтобы видели его￥лицо.

strings.en_src: Only the back of his head.
strings.long_src: All I can see from here is the back￥of his head.
There's no driver identification on￥display.

strings.en_src: No guide unit for Alphaville's￥automatic traffic system either.
strings.long_src: It doesn't have a guidance unit for￥Alphaville's automated traffic￥system, either.
strings.long: И блока наведения для автоматической￥транспортной системы "Альфавиля"￥тоже нет.

strings.long_src: He's a man of average height and￥build.

strings.en: Пока он сидит, точный рост не￥вычислить.
strings.en_src: He's seated, so I can't reckon his￥height.
strings.long_src: I can't calculate his exact height￥while he's seated.

strings.en_src: This is an unlicensed taxi. Don't￥ask too many questions.

strings.en: Правило простое: пассажир и водитель￥не лезут в дела друг друга.
strings.en_src: The rule is simple: passengers and￥drivers mind their own business.

strings.en: Прошу вас, господин. Перестаньте.￥Так куда едем?
strings.en_src: Please, sir. Stop that. Now, where￥to?
